name: genesis402-mcp
description: MCP server for the Genesis402 x402 rail (twin.unykorn.org): 360 pay-per-call endpoints - DeFi yields and market data, SEC filings and financials, wallet/token due diligence and sanctions screening, web and domain intelligence, AI text tools (extract, classify, translate, text-to-SQL), OpenAI-compatible chat and embeddings, and reads across Base, Ethereum, Solana, Stellar, XRPL and Bitcoin. Pays USDC on Base via x402 v2. Quote-only by default. Also hosted at https://twin.unykorn.org/mcp.
